timestamps: decoded video milliseconds, fps fallback only if unavailable/non-monotonic
sampling: first decoded frame at/after each requested real-time sample, no repeated stale frames

normalization.aspect_ratio: x and z multiplied by image_width/image_height; y unchanged
normalization.fixed_anchor: median wrist of first at most 3 detected samples
normalization.fixed_palm_scale: median Euclidean wrist-to-middle-MCP distance over detected samples
normalization.left_right: no inference mirroring; training optionally mirrors whole trajectories

missing_detection.coordinates: interpolate short gaps; nearest detected coordinate at short clip edges
missing_detection.failed_clips: rejected and reported, never relabeled as OTHER

no_hand_policy: Reject before temporal classification when no usable landmarks exist. Synthetic OTHER does not train a no-hand image detector.
temporal_resampling: linear interpolation to a fixed length over the complete sampled clip timeline; no automatic trimming of gesture starts/ends
hand_selection: largest hand initially, then nearest wrist for temporal continuity
integration_warning: Future Flutter implementation must use this sequence contract and actual frame timestamps. The existing approximately 320 ms detector interval is not the requested 15 fps. A repeated old landmark must not be treated as a new observation.
